extracted.INDICATION_ELIGIBILITY_WARNING: Mounjaro is approved for type 2 diabetes, NOT for weight management. Zepbound is the weight-management tirzepatide. Same molecule, different indication and different label. Any eligibility logic that offers Mounjaro to a user seeking weight-loss treatment is presenting an off-label pathway and is a clinical and compliance hazard. This distinction is confirmed by the drugs' labels as a matter of general record but the label text itself was not read in this session (fda.gov and lilly.com both denied).
